import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root = Path.cwd()
u = Path('research/draft_reviews/finite-moments')
r = u / 'replay'
def read(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_text())
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
v = read(u / 'verdict.json')
provenance = read(r / 'provenance_before.json')
binding = read(r / 'lean_binding.json')
lean = read(r / 'lean_verification.stdout.json')
certificate = read(Path(binding['certificate']))
state = read(Path('research/MATH_STATE.json'))
claim = next(c for c in state['claims'] if c['claim_id'] == 'C_REPLAY_ALG')
finite = read(r / 'finite/default.status.json')
jac = read(r / 'jacobian/adapter_status.json')
checks = {}
json_files = [p for p in u.rglob('*.json') if r / 'dependencies' not in p.parents]
for p in json_files:
    read(p)
checks['unit_json_documents_parse'] = True
ast.parse((r / 'replay_evidence.py').read_text())
checks['replay_wrapper_syntax_valid'] = True
checks['required_nonacceptance_and_exploratory_fields'] = (
    v['final_acceptance'] == 'pending_native_independent_review'
    and v['research_target_level'] == 'exploratory'
    and v['review_result_novelty_status'] == 'not_applicable'
    and v['assessment_role'] == 'Engineer evidence worker, not independent Reviewer'
)
checks['all_assertions_have_separate_support_and_open_status'] = all(
    a.get('mathematical_support') and a.get('open_status') for a in v['assertions']
)
checks['source_hash_fidelity_hash_and_old_archive_binding'] = (
    sha(r / 'Main.lean') == v['provenance']['source_sha256'] == lean['source_sha256']
    and sha(r / 'statement_fidelity.md') == v['provenance']['fidelity_sha256'] == lean['statement_fidelity_sha256']
    and all(provenance['binding_checks'].values())
    and all(binding['checks'].values())
)
checks['certificate_contains_actual_fresh_native_check'] = (
    certificate['lean_check'] == {k: val for k, val in lean.items() if k != 'kernel'}
    and certificate['subject']['subject_id'] == 'C_REPLAY_ALG'
    and certificate['subject']['content_hash'] == claim['content_hash']
    and claim['formal_statement'] == (r / 'Main.lean').read_text()
    and certificate['lean_source']['text'] == claim['formal_statement']
    and lean['status'] == 'success' and lean['exit_code'] == 0
    and lean['proof_holes'] == [] and lean['audit_exit_code'] == 0
)
formal_files = sorted(p.as_posix() for p in u.rglob('*.lean'))
checks['every_current_unit_formal_source_bound_to_successful_run'] = (
    formal_files == sorted([(r / 'Main.lean').as_posix(), (r / 'lean_evidence/Main.lean').as_posix()])
    and all(sha(Path(p)) == lean['source_sha256'] for p in formal_files)
)
checks['no_unit_lakefile_created'] = not list(u.rglob('lakefile.lean')) and not list(u.rglob('lakefile.toml'))
checks['finite_default_actual_exit_output_and_exact_no_write_command'] = (
    finite['exit_code'] == 0 and not finite['timed_out'] and finite['stderr_bytes'] == 0
    and finite['command'] == ['$WORKSPACE/argus-latest/.venv/bin/python', 'families/065/first-pass/family_orbit_localization/verify.py']
    and (root / finite['stdout_file']).read_text().startswith('PASS: typed Jacobian replay;')
    and sha(r / 'finite/archived_exact_certificate.json') == sha(Path('families/065/first-pass/family_orbit_localization/exact_certificate.json'))
)
comparison = read(r / 'jacobian/independent_comparison.json')
checks['sole_live_adapter_status_and_independent_comparison'] = (
    jac['exit_code'] == 0 and not jac['timed_out'] and jac['structured_error'] is None
    and jac['command'][0] == '$WORKSPACE/argus-live-update/.venv/bin/python'
    and jac['operation_id'] == 'matrix.symbolic.multiply.compute'
    and jac['server']['version'] == '0.14.0' and jac['protocol_version'] == '2025-11-25'
    and jac['payload_byte_identical_to_old']
    and comparison['status'] == 'pass' and all(comparison['checks'].values())
)
checks['verdict_measurements_match_real_receipts'] = (
    v['replays']['finite_default']['duration_ms'] == finite['duration_ms']
    and v['replays']['lean']['compiler_and_audit_duration_ms'] == lean['duration_ms']
    and v['replays']['jacobian']['adapter_duration_ms'] == jac['duration_ms']
    and v['replays']['jacobian']['server_runtime_ms'] == comparison['server_runtime_ms']
    and v['replays']['lean']['immutable_certificate'] == binding['certificate']
)
checks['old_26_artifacts_still_byte_unchanged'] = len(provenance['old_inventory']) == 26 and all(
    sha(Path(item['path'])) == item['sha256'] for item in provenance['old_inventory']
)
current_review = {
    'claims': [c for c in state['claims'] if c['claim_id'] == 'C_REVIEW'],
    'evidence': [e for e in state['evidence'] if e.get('subject', {}).get('subject_id') == 'C_REVIEW'],
}
checks['C_REVIEW_unchanged_no_mechanical_evidence_attached'] = (
    current_review == provenance['current_C_REVIEW_before']
    and not [e for e in current_review['evidence'] if e['tier'] == 'mechanical']
)
for label in ('post_registration', 'post_lean', 'final'):
    for module in ('math_state', 'proof_graph_check'):
        s = read(r / 'checks' / label / (module + '.status.json'))
        checks[f'{label}_{module}_exact_root_exit_0'] = (
            s['exit_code'] == 0 and not s['timed_out']
            and s['command'] == ['$WORKSPACE/argus-latest/.venv/bin/python', '-m', 'argus_skill.verticals.math.' + module, 'check', '--project-root', str(root)]
            and s['cwd'] == str(root)
            and s['stderr_bytes'] == 0
        )
        if module == 'math_state':
            checks[f'{label}_math_state_ok_no_issues'] = read(Path(s['stdout_file'])) == {'ok': True, 'issues': []}
        else:
            checks[f'{label}_graph_valid_7'] = Path(s['stdout_file']).read_text().strip() == 'proof graph valid: 7 node(s)'
graph = read(Path('research/PROOF_GRAPH.json'))
checks['graph_7_nodes_remain_open_unconfirmed'] = len(graph['nodes']) == 7 and all(
    n['status'] == 'open' and not n['reviewer_confirmed'] for n in graph['nodes'].values()
)
checks['report_and_verdict_persistent'] = (u / 'report.md').is_file() and (u / 'verdict.json').is_file()
result = {
    'status': 'pass' if all(checks.values()) else 'failure',
    'checks': checks,
    'checked_json_document_count': len(json_files),
    'formal_sources': formal_files,
    'failures': [k for k, value in checks.items() if not value],
    'scope': 'Artifact and binding validation only; not independent mathematical acceptance or review-completeness certification.',
}
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if all(checks.values()) else 1)
